decision.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the source mug's requested move to the right of the headphones complete, incomplete with visible progress, or not made?
decision.criteria: Pass only if visual correspondence establishes that the source mug is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image, satisfying the requested move. Fail if the source mug is identifiable and remains at its source-side position with no visible progress toward the right. Also fail if the source mug is identifiable and evidence establishes that it has not moved toward the right, even if unrelated objects or edits are present. If the source mug's appearance or location has visibly changed, or a plausible corresponding mug has moved toward the right while remnants remain, treat this as incomplete progress and fail rather than pass. Do not count a right-side mug alone as completion, or infer no progress solely from a pale mug left of the headphones or an indistinct blue patch at the source location. Use unknown only when source-to-edited correspondence or whether any progress occurred cannot be determined from the images.
decision.binding: Compare the source image's light-blue mug—including its body shape, handle, appearance, scale, and original position left of the headphones—with all mug-like objects and visible remnants in the edited image. Assess the pale mug left of the headphones, the mug right of them, and the blue-looking blurred patch at far left as possible correspondence evidence. Altered color, size, or appearance alone does not rule out identity; neither the patch nor the left mug conclusively establishes identity or lack of movement. Determine whether the source mug is visibly to the right of the headphones, has plausibly moved toward the right but remains short of the requested position, or shows no discernible progress. Base the decision on source-to-edited visual evidence and the requested move, not mug count or right-side position alone; retain unknown if correspondence or progress remains genuinely indeterminate.
